```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} (t : Finset ι) (s : ι → Set α) : (⋃ i ∈ t, s i).ncard ≤ ∑ i ∈ t, (s i).ncard := by
  induction t using Finset.induction_on with []
  · exact ncard_le_self
  · intros i t' h t'' h'
    have h1 : (⋃ i' ∈ t', s i').ncard ≤ ∑ i' ∈ t', (s i').ncard :=
      h t' h
    have h2 : (⋃ i' ∈ t'', s i').ncard ≤ ∑ i' ∈ t'', (s i').ncard :=
      h t'' h'
    rw [Union_union_left]
    apply ncard_le_add
    exact h1
    exact h2
```
